contact_edits.before: As their oppressor-in-chief, Scott Wentworth indulges in too much tooth-baring villainy but has subtler stuff in reserve. Stephen Kent shows nervous promise as a vacillating Grand Master. Stratford royalty Geraint Wyn Davies and Seana McKenna play the Spanish royalty, though neither performance is likely to add substantially to its owner's resume. (McKenna -- something I never thought I would say of her -- comes close to phoning it in.) The pair are depicted as benevolent autocrats, suggesting that Lope was sucking up to the dynasty that sheltered him. This production accepts that, putting a conservative spin on a play that can easily be interpreted as a blazing call to revolution. It isn't the very best show at Stratford this year but it may be the most encouraging. - Fuente Ovejuna runs until Oct. 4. For tickets and info, call 1-800-567-1600 or visit www.stratfordfestival.ca.
